governance.attested_by: miso-45 registration, MISO CC merit-order deep-diagnostic session 2026-07-07 (G-23)
governance.note: miso-45 = miso-44 recipe with ONE structural change: cc_capacity_reconcile ON with the MISO demonstrated-capacity cap table (data/raw/_processed-legacy/cc_capacity_reconcile_MISO.csv, scripts/derive_cc_capacity_reconcile.py --iso MISO --mode cap). Root cause (G-23 audit, docs/multi-iso/miso-cc-overrun-rootcause-2026-07.md): EIA-860 reports 7 MISO CC plants' steam (CA) rows with BLOCK-level Summer Capacity while nameplate stays component-level; the loader's summer-preferred pmax double-counts the CTs (-2,714 MW phantom CC_REGULAR, 6 of 7 plants MISO-South — the keeper's zonal overrun signature). The cap anchors each plant AT its measured CAMPD p99.9 sustained peak (EIA-860 winter capacity corroborates within ~5%). Zero new free parameters: the cap value is the plant's own measured capability; the derive-script guards (cap-margin 1.10, EIA-923 CF-feasibility, pure-play-CC gate) are the pre-existing shared artifact rules (PJM precedent, pjm-75). Rule-13 admissible: demonstrated capability regenerates forward from the rolling CEMS record and responds to uprates/derates; it bounds capacity at capability, never dispatch at outcome.
governance.validation_note: Reproducible from the committed bundle: scripts/run_calibration_full.py --iso MISO --year 2023 2024 2025 --cc-capacity-reconcile --coal-econ-srmc-bound --reliability-floor --coal-prb-sigmoid --coal-mustrun-per-plant --coal-drop-pof --prb-sigmoid-tiered --coal-bit-sigmoid --ct-intermediate-split --cc-intermediate-split --st-gas-intermediate --energy-reserve-coopt --miso-zonal-reserves --miso-reserve-pergen --miso-zonal-gas-basis --reference-price-interface --miso-firm-imports --miso-seam-flow-limit --miso-seam-export-limit --miso-pjm-border-anchor --out-dir results/calibration/MISO/miso_45_cc_capacity_cap (14 GB swap + MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=1 MARKET_SIM_HIGHS_THREADS=1). RESULT vs miso-44: CC_REGULAR +20.0/+19.1/+3.1 -> +6.7/+7.2/-7.3 TWh (2023/24/25); ST_GAS -8.5/-11.0/-10.5 -> -2.0/-4.6/-6.1; CT_PEAKER 2023 -6.2 -> -4.2; COAL_BIT 2023 -5.3 -> -4.0; gross imports 2023 30.5 -> 35.1 TWh. 2025 CC flips to -7.3 and coal absorbs (+32 PRB+BIT vs +28) - the residual moves onto the already-open import-starvation (gross imports 3.4 vs actual net 19.0 TWh) and coal-sigmoid rows of the G-23 audit (docs/multi-iso/miso-cc-overrun-rootcause-2026-07.md boxes 3-4); the cap is measured capability and stays regardless (rule 14). Legitimacy diagnostics: Overall PASS (D-1, D-2, D-4, D-5, D-9, D-10). Zero-forcing ablation twin registered alongside.

exceptions.classification: ACCEPTED MEASURED-INPUT LIMITATION (benchmark basis mismatch — not a model miss)
exceptions.reason: EIA-930 MISO reports NO pumped-storage series (verified: the PS column is all-null in every scored year of the balance files); the 0.245 TWh actual is battery-only, while the model side includes the 2,417 MW EIA-860 PS fleet (Ludington + Taum Sauk). The model's PS throughput sits INSIDE the eGRID net-energy-implied gross-discharge band (2.5-4.4 TWh depending on RTE basis) — the model is not over-cycling. No adder is admissible (PSH O&M < $1/MWh; the PJM $10 adder precedent in constants.py retired exactly this class of fit-to-mismeasured-target). Closable only in the scorer: compare battery-only model discharge vs NG: BAT when a BA reports battery-only (flagged to rubric infra). Full adjudication: results/calibration/FINDING-miso-c5b-storage-benchmark-2026-07.md.
